{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Remove sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
trial_df = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute change in biomarker: final - baseline
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute response rate per arm
response_rate_control = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

# Compute average biomarker change per arm
avg_change_control = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change'].mean()
avg_change_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Stratify by severity and compute response rate and biomarker change within each severity level
response_rate_control_mild = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'mild')]['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment_mild = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'mild')]['responded'].mean()

response_rate_control_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]['responded'].mean()

response_rate_control_severe = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe')]['responded'].mean()
response_rate_treatment_severe = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe')]['responded'].mean()

# Compute average biomarker change within each severity level
avg_change_control_mild = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'mild')]['biomarker_change'].mean()
avg_change_treatment_mild = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'mild')]['biomarker_change'].mean()

avg_change_control_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]['biomarker_change'].mean()
avg_change_treatment_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]['biomarker_change'].mean()

avg_change_control_severe = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe')]['biomarker_change'].mean()
avg_change_treatment_severe = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe')]['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Print results
print("\nResponse rates by arm and severity:")
print(f"Control - mild: {response_rate_control_mild:.3f}")
print(f"Treatment - mild: {response_rate_treatment_mild:.3f}")
print(f"Control - moderate: {response_rate_control_moderate:.3f}")
print(f"Treatment - moderate: {response_rate_treatment_moderate:.3f}")
print(f"Control - severe: {response_rate_control_severe:.3f}")
print(f"Treatment - severe: {response_rate_treatment_severe:.3f}")

print("\nAverage biomarker change by arm and severity:")
print(f"Control - mild: {avg_change_control_mild:.2f}")
print(f"Treatment - mild: {avg_change_treatment_mild:.2f}")
print(f"Control - moderate: {avg_change_control_moderate:.2f}")
print(f"Treatment - moderate: {avg_change_treatment_moderate:.2f}")
print(f"Control - severe: {avg_change_control_severe:.2f}")
print(f"Treatment - severe: {avg_change_treatment_severe:.2f}")"}
